answer: The canyon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tide is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
